newsitem.title: UK: Chrysler, Rover plan car deal -- report.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler, Rover plan car deal -- report.

text.p: Bayerische Motoren-Werke's Rover and Chrysler Corp plan an alliance to make a new range of saloon cars in Britain and the U.S., the Sunday Times newspaper said.

The report said a deal could come within the next few months, and for BMW could halve the 500 million stg cost of developing a new model to replace the Rover 400 model and larger versions of the Rover 200.
The report follows similar conjecture in the U.S. about a tie-up between the U.S. and German companies, who already have a joint venture to produce engines.

Last month, Automotive News said Chrysler planned a joint venture with a European carmaker for a new car between the Chrysler Neon and the Stratus in size. A European Chrysler source said the partner was BMW-Rover, the magazine said.
